name: UrbanIR
definition: A method for inverse rendering of large-scale urban scenes from a single monocular video under single illumination, inferring shape, albedo, visibility, and sun/sky illumination to enable relighting and night simulation.
summary: UrbanIR is an inverse rendering method for large-scale urban scenes that infers intrinsic attributes independent of lighting, enabling relighting from a single monocular video unlike standard NeRFs.
